metadata.title: Global weak varifold solutions to Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system
metadata.abstract: The Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system describes a two-phase flow of incompressible, viscous and immiscible fluids separated by a sharp interface, whose evolution is governed by a convective mean curvature flow equation, coupled to a two-phase Navier-Stokes equation accounting for surface tension. Among others, this model describes the dynamics of dry foams and it also arises as a sharp interface limit of Navier-Stokes/Allen-Cahn systems with non-vanishing mobility. Despite this wide range of applications, global-in-time existence of any kind of weak solutions remains a challenging open problem. In this work, we introduce a novel notion of varifold weak solution in two and three ambient dimensions, based on a sharp energy dissipation principle à la De Giorgi, and we show for the first time the unconditional global-in-time existence of such a weak solution. We also show, by means of a relative entropy approach, that any classical solution to the Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system is unique in the class of our new weak varifold solutions.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Navier–Stokes 与平均曲率流的全局弱解
analysis.workSummary: 在二维、三维平坦环面上，对 BV 初始相位和平方可积无散速度，构造 Newtonian 两相 Navier–Stokes 与可渗透界面平均曲率流耦合系统的全时间 De Giorgi varifold 解。把界面物质速度相对于 varifold 质量测度定义，以锐能量耗散不等式替代逐点平均曲率关系；变分最小移动与物质导数离散化避开对速度界面迹的额外控制。粘度相同时，相对熵和体积误差估计证明经典解存在期间的弱强唯一性。
analysis.breakthrough: 为表面张力和可动界面耦合系统给出全局弱解框架。
analysis.limitations: 边界条件为周期型，表面张力和渗透率为正常数；存在性允许不同粘度，但本文弱强唯一性要求两相粘度相同。当前模型不保持各相体积，保体积变体留待后续研究。
